meta.name: battle-card-builder
meta.description: Research and draft a competitive battle card from public evidence — every claim labeled and sourced. Use when a rep needs a field-action card, not a research report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成带来源标注的竞争分析卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果销售团队需要快速获取可验证的竞争情报。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly draft competitive battle cards with sourced claims.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your sales team needs fast, verifiable competitive intelligence.

howto.what: Claude 会按固定流程做公开信息调研(定价页、更新日志、评论、客户案例等),生成一张面向销售的竞争对战卡:每条说法都带来源链接、日期和“事实/推断/假设”标签,30 秒可读完,并附证据表和待验证假设。
howto.when: 当销售需要一张能直接上场的竞争对战卡(而非研究报告),并提供你的产品和某个竞品时触发;也可在手头已有竞品快照或监控报告时生成。

say.text: CRM对比Salesforce对战卡,中型销售VP,输单原因是对方集成更深。
say.note: Claude 会先补问最多3个问题,再产出带标注的卡片。

say.text: 基于这份竞品快照,直接生成对战卡,只补查缺口和超过一季度的旧数据。
say.note: 它会优先用已有证据,节省搜索时间。

say.text: 对战卡做好了,模拟对方销售跟我做压力测试。
say.note: 对应最后一个步骤里的压力测试选项。

howto.what_en: Claude researches public sources (pricing pages, release notes, reviews, customer stories) and drafts a battle card: every claim has source URL, date, and Fact/Inference/Assumption label; 30-second read, plus evidence table and assumptions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a rep needs a field-action battle card (not a research report), given your product and one competitor; also runs when a competitive snapshot or watch report is in session.

say_en.text: Battle card: our CRM vs Salesforce, mid-market VPs, they win on integrations.
say_en.note: It asks up to 3 questions, then drafts the card with sources.

say_en.text: Use this snapshot; build the card; search gaps and data older than 1 quarter.
say_en.note: Existing evidence is reused, so search is limited to gaps and stale data.

say_en.text: The card is ready - role-play the competitor's rep and pressure-test it.
say_en.note: This runs the Final Step pressure-test option.
